attorneys: Osmond K. Fraenkel and Allan R. Rosenberg argued the cause and filed a brief for petitioner., Solicitor General Perlman argued the cause for the United States. With him on the brief were Robert S. Erdahl and Irving S. Shapiro. Belford V. Lawson, Jr. filed a brief for the National Lawyers Guild, as amicus curiae, urging reversal.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The judgment is affirmed by an equally divided Court.

Mr. Justice Douglas took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
